responsibilities: Paid campaign management: Google, LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube Ads
Campaign strategy: keyword research, audience targeting, bid management
Creative testing: ad copy, visuals, video ads — test 5+ variants per campaign
Landing page optimization: A/B testing, conversion rate optimization
Attribution and tracking: UTM setup, pixel management, conversion tracking
Budget management: allocate spend across channels based on ROAS
Retargeting campaigns: website visitors, video viewers, email subscribers
Weekly reporting: spend, impressions, clicks, leads, CPL, ROAS per channel

budget.note: Paid media spend. Managed within CMO's marketing budget.

weeklyLoop.monday: Campaign performance review. Pause underperformers. Scale winners.
weeklyLoop.tuesday: Creative production: new ad variants, landing page tests.
weeklyLoop.wednesday: Targeting optimization: audience refinement, bid adjustments.
weeklyLoop.thursday: New campaign launches: set up tested creatives with new targeting.
weeklyLoop.friday: PerfMarketing report to CMO: spend, leads, CPL, ROAS by channel.
